records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total Revenue: Total revenue for the second quarter of 2022 increased 1% as compared to the first quarter of 2022 primarily due to increases in both DRAM and NAND sales partially offset by decreases in 3D XPoint sales, which ceased in the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Sales of DRAM products increased 2% primarily due to a high-single-digit percent increase in bit shipments partially offset by a mid-single-digit percent decline in average selling prices.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In some cases, we have added alternative suppliers, executed long-term supply agreements, and increased our on-hand inventory of raw materials needed in our operations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Sales of NAND products increased 4% primarily due to a mid-single-digit percent increase in average selling prices.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •CNBU operating income increased primarily due to higher bit shipments and manufacturing cost reductions partially offset by declines in DRAM average selling prices and higher R&D expenses.
